ngaap.guidance: Wabtec issues 2024 financial guidance with sales expected to be in a range of $10.05 billion to $10.35 billion and adjusted earnings per diluted share to be in a range of $6.50 to $6.90. For full year 2024, Wabtec expects strong cash flow generation with operating cash flow conversion of greater than 90 percent.
ngaap.notes: Wabtec 'adjusted' results exclude restructuring (Integration 2.0 and Portfolio Optimization) costs and non-cash intangible amortization expense, each tax-effected; also excludes the ~$35m non-taxable gain on remeasurement of the previously held 50% LKZ (Kazakhstan locomotive JV) interest recorded in Other income. EBITDA = income from operations + other income (expense) + D&A; Adjusted EBITDA adds the restructuring costs shown in the EBITDA table (excludes restructuring already within D&A, e.g. accelerated depreciation/asset write-downs, so it differs from the adjusted-table restructuring add-back). Cash conversion table D&A (incl. deferred debt cost amortization): 531; operating cash flow conversion 1201/(825+531).
